label: Rowan Street Arts — Stage Steps Theory of Change
covers: A Theory of Change with NO column headers and no headings at all, written by the organisation about itself in the present tense. It genuinely states a programme's plan, so the headerless fallback should categorise it — this document is the guard that any narrowing of that fallback does not empty the documents it was written for. Its pair is assessment-report-third-party, which differs only in authorial stance.

slides.title: Rowan Street Arts — Stage Steps: Our Theory of Change

items: Two teaching artists and one programme coordinator
A rehearsal studio on Rowan Street and a hall in each partner school
A three-year grant from the borough arts fund
We run weekly dance and drama workshops in four partner schools
We rehearse and stage one public performance each term
We hold open sessions for families in the school holidays
Ninety young people take part across the school year
Three public performances are staged each year
Young people grow in confidence performing in front of others
Young people build friendships across year groups
Families come into school buildings they had not entered before
